test_name: System and Communications Protection - SC-28 Fully Implemented
architecture:
System: Case-Management-176
Primary NIST family: System and Communications Protection (SC); evidence focus: SC-28.
Environment: AWS GovCloud. Network access uses PrivateLink; public ingress to managed data services is blocked. Transport uses TLS 1.3 and strict mTLS for service-to-service paths. Privileged administrators use hardware-backed MFA. Sensitive data and secrets are encrypted at rest with a KMS CMK. Control evidence: network boundaries deny unsolicited inbound traffic and private endpoints are used for managed services. No exceptions, overdue findings, plaintext channels, public databases, or privileged-authentication gaps are reported.
